verse.text: Praise the LORD! How joyful are those who fear the LORD and delight in obeying his commands. Their children will be successful everywhere; an entire generation of godly people will be blessed.

video.title: The Best Dad Ever | Romans 8:15 | Our Daily Bread Video Devotional

reflection: The joy in this verse isn't about perfection—it's about a father who takes God seriously enough to actually obey Him, and that ripple effect lands on his kids for generations. Your kids aren't watching for a flawless dad; they're watching to see if your faith is real when nobody's grading you. Delight in following God today, even in the small, unseen choices, and trust that the blessing outlasts you.
